title: Planisphere
summary: PLAN'ISPHERE, noun [Latin planus, plain, and sphere.] A sphere projected on a plane, in which sense, maps in which are exhibited the meridians and other circles, are planispheres.

inlines.v: PLAN'ISPHERE, noun [Latin planus, plain, and sphere.] A sphere projected on a plane, in which sense, maps in which are exhibited the meridians and other circles, are planispheres.
